normalization: Sum of arm joint-origin translation lengths normalized to 1 m; gripper unchanged
collision: Full STL triangle intersections; closed-mesh containment; open-mesh surface intersections only
ignored_pairs: Direct arm neighbors, mechanical gripper mount, base/finger joints; holding additionally allows intended finger/payload contact
joint_limits: Original model limits retained; different across designs

targets.open: Grasp TCP 155 mm from gripper base
targets.holding: Same grasp TCP with 30 mm cube attached

cumulative: Count with >= threshold accepted orientations / all reachable grid points; exclude 0/16
caveats: P2AB-3 uses revised upward mounting on opposite flange side; physical mounting compatibility is not verified.
Workspace IK acceptance does not prove a collision-free path to each pose.
Bare flange and gripper TCP are different target points; gripper extension changes reach.
8 existing gripper results reused; 10 new cases recalculated with matching settings.
collision_implementation: Original repository implementation for every reported workspace result; experimental prefilter not used.
